about.title: About Nomad Agro
about.pageSubtitle: A Tashkent-based organic exporter connecting Uzbekistan's finest farms with wholesale buyers worldwide.

story.title: Our Story
story.text: Founded in Tashkent, Nomad Agro was born from a deep respect for Uzbekistan's ancient agricultural traditions and a vision to connect its premium organic produce with buyers around the world. We work directly with farmers in the foothill regions — where centuries of organic farming have been preserved by geography and tradition — to bring you products of exceptional purity and quality.

regions.title: Growing Regions
regions.text: Our products are sourced from Uzbekistan's foothill regions, where altitude, soil composition, and a continental climate create ideal conditions for growing exceptional dried fruits, nuts, and legumes — entirely naturally, without artificial inputs.

process.title: From Farm to Export
process.text: We oversee every step: farmer partnerships, harvesting, natural drying and processing, quality inspection, packaging, and international shipping. Our team ensures your order meets the exact specifications you need.

certifications.title: Quality & Compliance
certifications.text: Our products are prepared in compliance with phytosanitary and export standards, ensuring smooth customs clearance in your destination market. We provide all required export documentation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions from wholesale buyers and importers.

items.question: Where are Nomad Agro's products grown?
items.answer: Our dried fruits, nuts, and mung beans are grown and sourced from the foothill regions of Uzbekistan — including the Fergana Valley, Surkhandarya, and Samarkand areas — where altitude, fertile soil, and a continental climate produce exceptional natural quality.

items.question: Does Nomad Agro export internationally?
items.answer: Yes. Nomad Agro is a Tashkent-based B2B exporter supplying wholesale buyers across Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. We handle all export documentation, phytosanitary certificates, and logistics coordination.

items.question: Are the products organic and certified?
items.answer: Our products are grown using organic methods — no mineral fertilizers, no chemical treatments. We prepare all required export and phytosanitary documentation. Please contact us for specific certification details relevant to your market.

items.question: How do I request a price quote?
items.answer: Prices are not published online as they change daily with crop availability and market conditions. Contact us directly via email at info@nomadagro.uz, WhatsApp, or Telegram for current pricing and availability.

items.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.answer: Minimum order quantities vary by product and packaging. Please contact us to discuss your specific requirements — we work with both container-load orders and smaller wholesale quantities.

items.question: What packaging options are available?
items.answer: We offer various packaging options including 25kg and 50kg bulk bags, as well as custom packaging upon request. Contact us to discuss the best option for your market and logistics requirements.

driedFruits.title: Organic Dried Fruits
driedFruits.description: Sourced from Uzbekistan's sun-rich foothill regions, our dried fruits are naturally dried — no preservatives, no sulfites, no artificial coloring. Each variety is carefully processed to preserve its natural sweetness and nutritional integrity.

items.name: Sun-Dried Apricots (Uryuk)
items.description: Naturally dried, sulfite-free apricots with a deep amber colour and concentrated sweetness. Available in multiple grades — soft and semi-dried.

items.name: Raisins (Kishmish)
items.description: Golden and dark raisins, naturally sun-dried from Uzbekistan's celebrated local grape varieties. Clean, sweet, and export-ready.

items.name: Dried Plums (Prunes)
items.description: Premium-grade prunes from Uzbek orchards — soft, intensely flavoured, and packed for export in various grades.

items.name: Dried Figs (Anjir)
items.description: Soft, naturally sweet figs — carefully hand-sorted, dried under the Uzbek sun, and packed for export markets.

items.name: Dried Mulberries (Tut)
items.description: White and black mulberries, one of Uzbekistan's most prized traditional dried fruits. Delicate, sweet, and naturally rich in nutrients.

items.name: Dried Dates (Xurmo)
items.description: Select varieties of naturally ripened and dried dates — premium grade for confectionery and health food markets.

nuts.title: Organic Nuts
nuts.description: Our nuts are sourced from the mountain orchards and foothill farms of Uzbekistan — harvested by hand, sorted by grade, and exported in export-standard packaging. Pure, unprocessed flavour from nature.

items.name: Walnuts (Yong'oq)
items.description: Light-coloured kernels with high oil content, sourced from Uzbekistan's highland walnut orchards. Available in-shell and shelled, multiple grades.

items.name: Almonds (Bodom)
items.description: Sweet-variety Uzbek almonds — available in-shell and shelled, raw or blanched. Clean, premium grade for confectionery and snack markets.

items.name: Pistachios (Pistа)
items.description: Naturally opened pistachios from Central Asian orchards — roasted or raw, in-shell or shelled, sorted by grade.

items.name: Hazelnuts (Funduq)
items.description: Round, sweet-flavoured hazelnuts — carefully sorted by grade for confectionery, baking, and snack market applications.

mungBeans.title: Mung Beans (Mash)
mungBeans.description: Uzbekistan is one of the world's leading producers of premium mung beans. Our mash is cleaned, machine-sorted, and available in several grades — whole green, split, and hulled — to meet diverse market specifications.

items.name: Whole Green Mung Beans
items.description: Premium-grade whole mung beans — thoroughly cleaned, machine-sorted, and export-ready in 25kg and 50kg bags.

items.name: Split Mung Beans (Mosh Dal)
items.description: Split and hulled mung beans for the Asian cooking ingredient and food manufacturing market.

items.name: Mung Bean Flour
items.description: Finely milled mung bean flour — available in custom grades for food manufacturing, noodle, and vermicelli production.
